summary:
Phase P9 Core repair discovered during controller review of P8: Recipe removal correctness must not depend on an embedding provider.

Verified failure:
- On accepted Core 627fd7d, VectorService with autoSyncOnCrud=true, a valid EventBus and embedProvider=null initializes with autoSyncEnabled=false.
- Emitting knowledge:deleted for an index containing entry_dead and recipe_region_dead_* produces removed=[].
- Plugin correctly degrades to keyword when Ollama/model is unavailable, so this is a normal supported runtime state, not an exceptional test-only condition.

Required behavior:
1. Decouple removal listeners from embedding. With autoSyncOnCrud and EventBus configured, delete and lifecycle transition to deprecated must remove entry_<id> and every recipe_region_<id>_* even when embedProvider is null/unavailable. Do not require Ollama for deletion.
2. Upsert/create/update/reactivate paths may honestly defer/degrade when no provider; they must not fabricate vector success or delete existing live Recipe chunks.
3. In syncRecipeSemanticRegionVectors authoritative-corpus mode, remove regions whose recipeId is absent from the complete authority set even when pending live chunks cannot be embedded. Preserve old chunks for still-live Recipes until replacement embedding succeeds. Subset mode remains unable to delete unrelated Recipes.
4. Ensure explicit reconcile/maintenance can remove entry and region orphans without a provider. Missing live vectors must not be falsely reported as synchronized when no embedding can occur; return an honest bounded deferred/degraded signal compatible with existing callers.
5. Preserve provider-available behavior, event payloads, replacement ordering, Search filtering, query read-only semantics and all no-gate/no-host-selection boundaries.
6. No Plugin edits, no live BiliDili/AlembicWorkspace mutations, no Test.

Validation:
- RED/GREEN exact runtime regression: embedProvider=null + delete/deprecate removes both vector families.
- Authoritative corpus fixture with provider null removes absent Recipe regions while retaining old live Recipe chunks and reports degradation for ungenerated replacements.
- Subset safety, provider-available update/reactivate regeneration, concurrent flush/destroy, reconcile count/error semantics.
- Focused vector/lifecycle suites, full Core tests, build/check/public API.
- Commit Core and return actual full commit hash, changed symbols, raw JSON probe, commands and two-stage self-review.
Completion unblocks P8 Plugin rework; it does not accept P8 or authorize real index cleanup.
sourceRef: Controller P8 review runtime probe on 2026-07-13: Core 627fd7d with embedProvider=null initialized autoSyncEnabled=false and knowledge:deleted removed no vectors.
designIntent: 把删除正确性与向量生成能力解耦：生成需要 embedding，删除不存在/废弃 Recipe 的派生向量不需要；live Recipe 的旧块只在新块成功后替换。

targetTasks.summary: 让 Recipe 删除、废弃和权威孤儿清理不依赖 embedding provider，同时保持 live Recipe 替换安全；修复无 Ollama 时仍产生孤儿向量的问题。
